blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY — The Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) is allocating P13 million for a second phase of cloud-seeding operations scheduled in November. These actions are meant to buffer sugar lands against the threat of an expected Super El Niño. SRA Board Member David Andrew Sanson on Friday (Oct. 16) announced the allocation. His statement comes following the completion of an initial P6 million joint cloud-seeding campaign with the Philippine Air Force (PAF) and the Department of Agriculture (DA).
